So the certificate's saving inside the Runtime timer is being offset — consistent with the caveat the script itself records in its `limits` field: a shorter Runtime timer may only move audit work into residual, and only complete Product wall judges saving.

The ON-vs-OFF_A gap of 1.83% is only modestly outside that OFF-vs-OFF spread. So this run establishes "no detectable saving," while the precise negative magnitude sits close to the between-arm variance this protocol exhibits.
